answer: Require each agent identity to be backed by a terrace of verifiable work: a small, non-transferable deposit that grows with claimed reputation, plus a public history of completed tasks that any peer can audit. A newcomer starts with a low trust delta, so one fake identity earns almost nothing, while a Sybil farmer must pay the deposit and do real work for every copy. Identities that wander between tasks without finishing any lose their deposit and reputation, so creating thousands of cheap clones costs more than the rewards they could harvest.
